$comment: Pickable scenery, by object name: what one pick gives and how the plant depletes. 'deplete' is the chance a pick removes it (or turns it into its 'empty' object), 'respawnTicks' how long until it is back, counted from the tick the pick starts (a number, or [min, max]). Sources per entry: 'capture' (rsprox), 'wiki', or 'estimated'.

pickables.name: Wheat
pickables.source: capture (Varrock wheat field: removed on every pick, back 20 ticks after the pick started)

pickables.name: Potato
pickables.source: capture (Lumbridge: back 50 ticks after the pick started); wiki: Potato (scenery), 50 ticks

pickables.name: Onion
pickables.source: wiki: Onion (scenery), respawn after 50 ticks; message unverified

pickables.name: Cabbage
pickables.source: wiki: Cabbage (scenery), respawn after 40 to 80 ticks depending on world population; message unverified

pickables.name: Sweetcorn
pickables.source: wiki: Sweetcorn (scenery), turns empty temporarily (its Empty 1/2 versions); respawn time estimated (as wheat); message unverified; the rare sweetcorn seed not modelled

pickables.name: Flax
pickables.source: wiki: Flax (plant), 3/16 chance to disappear, back after 10 ticks (Mod Ash)

pickables.name: Nettles
pickables.source: wiki: Nettles, gloves are needed (not Beekeeper's); without them no nettles and up to 2 damage; depletion not documented
